source: Free Agent Budget screenshots embedded in the 'Waiver Wire Dollars' workbook tab
note: What each owner had LEFT when the season ended. The starting budget for the next
season is $100 plus that leftover, capped (by-laws 6.3).
The workbook's yearly columns are starting budgets and are correct through 2023 —
end-of-2022 leftovers reproduce the 2023 column exactly for all ten teams. The last
column is mislabelled: it is headed 2024 but its values are exactly $100 + the
end-of-2024 leftovers, i.e. the 2025 starting budget. So 2024, 2025 and 2026 are
computed here instead of read from the sheet.
Caps: several teams sit at exactly $200 in 2019-2022, so the ceiling was $200 then.
The 2025 owners' meeting set it to $150 ('$150 is now the max starting position').
